title: WIPSNet: Deep Learning for Paediatric Wheeze Detection from Overnight Impedance Pneumography
abstract: arXiv:2610.00398v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Overnight impedance pneumography (IP) is used to monitor paediatric respiratory health. Its current clinical readout, the Expiratory Variability Index (EVI), compresses each IP recording into a single scalar and achieves an AUC of 0.633 for night-level wheeze classification. We introduce Wheeze Impedance Pneumography Scalogram Network (WIPSNet), a 3D ResNet operating on stacked continuous wavelet transform scalograms of overnight IP signals. On a 15-patient cohort (60 nights, 281 hours), WIPSNet achieves an AUC of $0.783 \pm 0.026$, outperforming EVI, a state-space model (Mamba), and two modern sleep-staging architectures. Performance peaks at a volumetric depth corresponding to 32 minutes of temporal context, suggesting that multi-scale temporal aggregation is important for modelling nocturnal respiratory dynamics. Overall, these results indicate that structured time-frequency representations combined with 3D convolutional architectures

translated_title: WIPSNet：基于整夜阻抗呼吸图的儿童喘息检测深度学习方法
translated_abstract: 整夜阻抗呼吸图（IP）被用于监测儿童呼吸健康。其目前的临床读数——呼气变异性指数（EVI）——将每段IP记录压缩为单个标量，在夜间水平的喘息分类中仅达到0.633的AUC。我们提出了喘息阻抗呼吸图尺度图网络（WIPSNet），这是一个运行在整夜IP信号的连续小波变换尺度图堆叠之上的3D ResNet。在一个包含15名患者（60晚、281小时）的队列中，WIPSNet实现了0.783 ± 0.026的AUC，优于EVI、状态空间模型（Mamba）以及两种现代睡眠分期架构。性能在与32分钟时间上下文相对应的体积深度处达到峰值，表明多尺度时间聚合对于建模夜间呼吸动态十分重要。总体而言，这些结果表明结构化时频表示与3D卷积架构相结合（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出WIPSNet，利用3D ResNet处理整夜阻抗呼吸图信号的小波时频尺度图，将儿童夜间喘息检测的AUC从传统EVI的0.633提升至0.783，显著优于现有方法。
